facts.fact: Jordan 一天折腾下来瘫在大床上只想睡觉，比起 Atlanta 那间墙薄到能听见邻居打喷嚏的公寓，这栋别墅是她的避难所。
facts.anchor: It was still light outside, but she was already exhausted.

facts.fact: 门铃响起时 Lily 躲进浴室（怕斧头杀人犯），来者是根据章别在胸的 Milo Hernandez——初级辅导员实习生，送来三封黑色信封。
facts.anchor: He was wearing a pin that read: “Milo Hernandez, Junior Counselor Trainee.”

facts.fact: Nan 的信说：她自己订了行程，几天后加入三个孩子；还"高兴 Jordan 期待去那里上 prep school"（原文误植 goging）。
facts.anchor: I took the liberty of making a reservation for myself, and will be joining you and your cousins in a couple of days!

facts.fact: Jordan 得知父母在温哥华给她报了预科学校——这是她从未听说的安排，攥着信直冲父母房间。
facts.anchor: But prep school? Her parents had enrolled her in PREP SCHOOL?

facts.fact: 摆渡车上遇上话痨 Mika（旧金山来、行李被航空公司弄丢、梦想上 FIT 当名人造型师）；她透露岛上只有几百客人，因为每周只有一班船往返 Miami。
facts.anchor: This place is huge, but there are only, like, a few hundred guests here since there’s only one ship that goes back and forth to Miami once a week

facts.fact: Tranquil Cove 成人区棕榈高耸、吊灯昏黄，树上藏着放蟋蟀声的喇叭，高科技过滤+无毒驱虫系统让岛上根本没有虫子。
facts.anchor: Thanks to some kind of high-tech insect filtration and nontoxic repellent system, there weren’t any bugs in Paradise!

facts.fact: Jordan 躲在盆栽后偷听：Suzie 说 Jordan 曾试图离家出走、听到预科学校可能再犯；Greg 说"没得选、被逼到墙角"，Suzie 反问"那怪谁，Greg？"
facts.anchor: “We don’t have a choice. Our backs are up against the wall.” “And whose fault is that, Greg?”

facts.fact: 最重磅的偷听：Greg 还没把发生的事告诉 Elliott——"他已经够恨 Mom 了，不想再给他一个理由"；Suzie 说 Elliott 知道后会气疯。
facts.anchor: “No, not yet. He already hates Mom enough. I don’t want to give him another reason.”
